## Fixes

- Fix release branch tagging so branch builds can publish `latest` and branch tags again.
- Avoid shell interpolation when passing Docker registry passwords to `docker login`.
- Handle Docker image default users that already include a group when generating ownership specs.
- Fix `wodby ci init --provider` so `-p` is the shorthand and the default provider is empty.
- Reject unknown service names passed to `wodby ci deploy`.
- Parse Dockerfile `ARG NAME=default` declarations correctly when resolving build args.
- Add a timeout to Wodby API HTTP requests.
- Fix DIND build context synchronization so repeated builds copy the working directory contents cleanly.

## Validation

- `go test ./...`
- `go vet ./...`
- `go test -race ./...`
